STEP 2 - Vessel: A square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across with rounded corners. Taking the stated formula, the area is 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm². Since the plate is square, the true area is a bit larger (~650 cm²), so I use ~600 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: Three slices of cheese pizza. The visible components are crust, tomato sauce and melted mozzarella.

STEP 4 - Area:

- Total coverage: ~27% ≈ 162 cm²

STEP 5 - Volume: 162 cm² × ~1.2 cm average height ≈ 194 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: 194 ml × 0.6 g/ml ≈ 116 g. I used a lower density than the listed bread-like 0.9–1.0 because pizza crust is somewhat airy; the result is ~115 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cheese pizza is about 270 kcal/100 g, so 115 g × 2.7 ≈ 310 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Three small slices at roughly 40 g each, about 100 kcal per slice, is plausible.
